meta.title: KalyChain — The Trust Infrastructure for the Real Economy
meta.description: KalyChain is a public, EVM-compatible, high-performance Layer 1 blockchain: sub-3-second finality, near-zero fees, and native rails for payments, stablecoins (KUSD) and mobile money.
meta.ogDescription: Sub-3-second finality, near-zero fees, EVM native. The settlement layer for payments, stablecoins and mobile money. Build on KalyChain.

hero.badgeBuilt: BUILT IN AFRICA · FOR THE WORLD
hero.tagline: For those who refuse imposed systems.
hero.subTagline: Inspired by 5000 years of innovation in decentralized systems.
hero.body: Humanity has always built alternatives to centralized systems. From the pyramids of Kemet to African tontines, from Ashanti gold to Bitcoin. KalyChain is the next evolution.

problem.lead: Financial and technological systems designed elsewhere. For others. With their rules. A global problem.
problem.noteA: Whether you are in Lagos, Buenos Aires, Manila or Paris, the problem is the same:

cards.title: Financial exclusion
cards.body: 1.4 billion people without a bank account. Africa, LATAM, Southeast Asia.

cards.title: Predatory fees
cards.body: 6 to 15% on international transfers. Mexico → USA, Philippines → Gulf, Africa → Europe.

cards.title: Glacial speed
cards.body: 3 to 5 days for a SWIFT transfer. Even between the USA and Europe.

cards.title: Tech monopolies
cards.body: Big Tech controls your data. Arbitrary censorship and deplatforming. In the West too.

heritage.lead: Decentralized systems are not new. They are as old as civilization. Africa perfected them over 5000 years. We are bringing them back.

governance.lead: KalyChain is a public blockchain. Its future is decided by those who use it, build it and believe in it.

kips.title: Governance Parameters V1
kips.body: Establishment of the initial governance parameters: 4% quorum, 7-day voting period.

kips.title: Regional Stablecoins Deployment
kips.body: Deployment of stablecoins pegged to regional currencies to drive local adoption.

kips.title: KalySwap V4 Migration
kips.body: Migration of KalySwap to V4 with the Vault NFT architecture and POL model.

steps.title: Get gKLC
steps.body: Convert your KLC into governance tokens (gKLC) to gain voting power.

steps.title: Vote or Propose

steps.title: Shape the Future

grants.lead: Concrete programs to reward those building the Renaissance — capital, competitions, and security.

grantCard.title: KalyChain Grants
grantCard.body: Up to $100K per project. Focus on DeFi, Infrastructure, Mobile-First. Applications open year-round.

hackathonCard.title: Quarterly Hackathons
hackathonCard.body: $50K in prizes per hackathon, 4 times a year. Themes: DeFi, Gaming, RWA, AI. KalyBot mentors included.

bountyCard.title: Bug Bounty Program
bountyCard.body: Up to $50K per critical vulnerability. Smart contracts, infra, security. Continuous audits by KalyBot.

story.quote: "With the KalyChain grant and the support of the KalyBot agents, we launched our yield gateway in 6 weeks. Today it manages over $12M in deposits."
story.disclaimer: Illustrative example of an awardee journey — the first official grants will be announced when the program opens.

security.lead: Trust is not declared, it is proven. Audits, compliance and progressive decentralization.

sustainability.lead: KalyChain runs on a hybrid PoA/PoS consensus — no energy-hungry mining. A world-class blockchain with the carbon footprint of a website.

commitments.title: Hybrid PoA/PoS consensus
commitments.body: Zero mining. Validators secure the network with minimal power consumption — the equivalent of a few servers.

commitments.title: Verified carbon offsetting
commitments.body: An offset partnership with a certified operator to neutralize 100% of the network's residual footprint.

commitments.title: Green Renaissance Fund
commitments.body: 1% of protocol fees fund reforestation and clean energy in West Africa — the DAO treasury allocates quarterly.
